method: Fresh sequential Qt offscreen processes. Lifecycle benchmark isolates file verification and simulates MainWindow synchronous currentTheme/definition reads on each of two switch-backs; no document/widget or input/display latency is included. Full document visuals are separately checked for 1/10/30 MiB. Detailed scopes are inclusive; do not sum. Cold means fresh application process, not flushed OS cache.
baseline_note: Baseline adds default-off file-read/hash scopes and callback stages; same Qt SHA-256 algorithm, bounded 256 KiB stream. Both binaries include built-in CSS/fonts.

manager_before.method: Sequential fresh offscreen processes; same immutable local CSS/font dependencies. Two return-to-theme cycles per process. Stage timings are not GUI event/display latency; detailed scopes are inclusive and cannot be summed. Images and sampled geometry/cursor hits are retained for before/after comparison. Full counter reference checked separately after timed stages.
